The decisive mistake was made by **Verification_Expert** at **step 5**. It was asked to check the Survivor count, which had come back as an implausible 192, but its replacement logic was still wrong. It collected every linked name from any wikitable containing a "Winner" header, which pulled in contestants who never won. The resulting 67 was far too high for 44 seasons, and the team accepted it without checking. That number carried into the Survivor-minus-Idol subtraction at steps 7 and 9, so the final answer of 53 could not match the correct answer of 21.
